description: xp-plugin lane-keeping, ONE file for both harnesses: Claude reads it from the manifest, Codex from its own hooks/hooks.json discovery. PostToolUseFailure is Claude-only and Codex ignores unknown event names without dropping the rest (measured, codex-cli 0.147.0).

hooks.command:
python3 -c 'import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path
root = Path(sys.argv[1])
name = sys.argv[2]
script = root / "scripts" / name
if script.is_file():
    os.execv(sys.executable, [sys.executable, str(script)])
if root.exists():
    print(f"hook script missing: {script}; pinned root exists", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(0)
try:
    siblings = [p for p in root.parent.iterdir() if p.is_dir() and p.name.split(".") and all(x.isdecimal() for x in p.name.split(".")) and (p / "scripts" / name).is_file()]
except OSError as error:
    print(f"hook root missing: {root}; sibling lookup failed: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(0)
if not siblings:
    print(f"hook root missing: {root}; no sibling has {name}", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(0)
chosen = max(siblings, key=lambda p: tuple(int(x) for x in p.name.split(".")))
print(f"hook root missing: {root}; running {chosen}", file=sys.stderr)
os.execv(sys.executable, [sys.executable, str(chosen / "scripts" / name)])' "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" session_start.py
